claimChecks.claim: The classic longitudinal/transverse axes apply unchanged to penoscrotal-web scrotoplasty

claimChecks.note: Web release incises transversely and closes vertically; classical luminal geometry is reverse.

claimChecks.claim: Heineke-Mikulicz scrotoplasty has equivalent pediatric success to Z-plasty
claimChecks.locator: Original Methods/Results and Discussion: randomized 20/20, 85% vs 95%, p=0.605
claimChecks.note: Small comparison found no significant difference; not proof of equivalence or long-term durability; operative time was shorter.
